params.1274: There are a number of ways to get flour:
params.1275: - Grind it from wheat in a windmill.
params.1276: - Buy it from Wydin in Port Sarim.
params.1277: - Buy it from the Grand Exchange.
params.2225: Flour is the basis of bread, pies, cakes and pizzas, all of which can be made with the Cooking skill.
